regions.text: た管て偶然或るダシス場で知合つた女優であつた。

quote.translation: That actress's friend, also an actress, turned out to be an actress he had once got to know by chance at a dance hall.

regions.text: すると間もなくまた偶然る本がそこへ出て来て、その本をデディケェトされてゐる男が「女優」と題する本を書いた男であつたといふのである（成淑無極、偶然関答四四図1図五〇）。

quote.translation: Then, shortly afterwards and again by chance, a certain book came up, and the man to whom that book is dedicated turned out to be the author of a book entitled The Actress (Naruse Mukyoku, Gūzen mondō 444-450).

regions.text: 「女優に出くわしたをいふ單一の偶然が同一性を以て三回継返されてある。

quote.translation: Here the single contingent "running into an actress" is repeated three times with identity.

regions.text: さて機起的偶然の橋成契機たる同時偶然がそれ自身において相償强い印聚力を有つ場合には、機起前偶然を成立させるために要する繰返しの同数は多いことを必要としない。二三同の繰返しで足りることは以上の諸例によつても知ることが出來る。

quote.translation: When the simultaneous contingencies that are the constitutive moments of a successive contingency have, in themselves, a fairly strong impressive force, the successive contingency does not need many repetitions to be constituted, and the examples above show that two or three suffice.

regions.text: しかしながら構成契機たる同時前偶然がそれ自身においては徹弱な印象力より有ってあない場合には、機起釣偶然を成立きせるためには繰返しの回敷の多いことを要するのである。

quote.translation: When, however, the constitutive simultaneous contingencies have in themselves no more than a weak impressive force, the successive contingency needs many repetitions before it is constituted.

regions.text: 要するのである。例へば最近十数年間の大震炎に競

quote.translation: Consider the great earthquakes of the last ten years or so.

regions.text: 例へば最近十数年間の大震炎に競て見るに、開東の震災は九月一日但馬の震災は五月二十三日丹後の震災は三月七日伊豆の震災は十一月二十六日であつた。

quote.translation: The Kantō earthquake fell on 1 September, the Tajima earthquake on 23 May, the Tango earthquake on 7 March and the Izu earthquake on 26 November.

regions.text: 九と一との合計五と二と三との合計三と七との合計一と一と二と六との合計はいづれも拾である。

quote.translation: Nine and one, five, two and three, three and seven, and one, one, two and six all add up to ten.

regions.text: 踊東の震災が九月一日すなはち月日の合計が拾である日に起つたといふこをは

quote.translation: That the Kantō earthquake occurred on 1 September, that is, on a day whose month and day add up to ten, is certainly a simultaneous contingency, but as a single isolated fact it hardly deserves notice.
